title: Keyword Research For Yoga Retreats: Free Guide

facts.fact: The guide was published on 19 October 2026.

facts.fact: The page recommends writing down 5-10 phrases that ideal retreat guests might search for as a starting keyword list.
facts.quote: Write down 5-10 phrases you think your ideal guests might search for.

facts.fact: The page recommends spending 15 minutes exploring the original keyword list in Google to add relevant suggestions.
facts.quote: Spend 15 minutes exploring your original keyword list in Google.

facts.fact: The competition metric in Keyword Planner relates to Google Ads, not to how difficult it is to rank organically in Google.
facts.quote: the competition metric in Keyword Planner relates to Google Ads, not how difficult it is to rank organically in Google.

facts.fact: Google Trends shows relative interest in searches rather than exact search volumes, so it is best used to identify patterns rather than predict bookings.
facts.quote: Google Trends shows relative interest rather than exact search volumes, so it's best used to identify patterns rather than predict bookings.

facts.fact: In Google Search Console, an impression generally means a website appeared in a Google search result, while a click means someone selected that result.
facts.quote: An **_impression_** generally means your website appeared in a Google search result, while a **_click_** means someone selected that result.

facts.fact: Long-tail keywords are more detailed searches that typically have narrower intent and may face less competition than broad terms.
facts.quote: They're more detailed searches that typically have narrower intent and may face less competition than broad terms.

facts.fact: Keyword cannibalisation happens when multiple pages on a website target the same search intent and compete with one another unnecessarily.
facts.quote: which happens when multiple pages on your website target the same search intent and compete with one another unnecessarily.

facts.fact: Keyword stuffing, meaning unnaturally repeating phrases to influence rankings, goes against Google's spam policies.
facts.quote: unnaturally repeating phrases in an attempt to influence rankings, can make your writing less useful and goes against Google's spam policies.

facts.fact: Most modern SEO plugins can manage canonical tags automatically, so manual configuration is usually unnecessary unless a website has duplicate or unusual page structures.
facts.quote: Most modern SEO plugins can manage canonical tags automatically. You don't need to configure them manually unless your website has duplicate or unusual page structures.

facts.fact: Google Search Console shows which searches are already generating impressions and clicks for a website.
facts.quote: It shows which searches are already generating impressions and clicks for your website.

facts.fact: Wildheart says it has spent 12 years working with yoga teachers and wellbeing businesses.
facts.quote: through 12 years of working with yoga teachers and wellbeing businesses

facts.fact: Wildheart's guide states that meaningful SEO growth often takes six months or longer, and improvements may appear within a few months.
facts.quote: You might notice improvements within a few months, but meaningful growth often takes six months or longer.

facts.fact: Wildheart's guide recommends focusing on one primary keyword and a handful of closely related phrases per page rather than many keywords.
facts.quote: focus on one primary keyword and a handful of closely related phrases

facts.fact: Wildheart's guide says free tools including Google Search, Google Trends and Google Keyword Planner can be used for keyword research without paid SEO software.
facts.quote: Free tools like Google Search, Google Trends and Google Keyword Planner can help you discover what people are searching for.

facts.fact: Wildheart's guide recommends using Google Search Console to track impressions and clicks for a live retreat website.
facts.quote: use Google Search Console to track impressions and clicks

facts.fact: Purple Valley, a yoga retreat centre in Goa, India, was a Wildheart client that began offering retreats in Tenerife, Spain, and Wildheart created separate SEO pages for 'Retreats in Goa' and 'Retreats in Tenerife'.
facts.quote: we created new SEO-optimised pages for ‘Retreats in Goa’ and ‘Retreats in Tenerife’

facts.fact: Wildheart's guide gives the example of a retreat page targeting 'yoga retreat in Portugal' with variations such as 'Portugal yoga holiday'.
facts.quote: a retreat page might focus on 'yoga retreat in Portugal', while naturally including variations such as 'Portugal yoga holiday'
